sourceAttempts.family: SCDNR Edisto River Basin Boating Guide
sourceAttempts.result: The official guide identifies Givhans gauge 02175000 and states best Edisto paddling conditions are 2–10 ft; below 2 ft requires portage and above 10 ft is flood/not recommended.

sourceAttempts.family: Edisto River Canoe and Kayak Trail access sites
sourceAttempts.result: ERCK documents public Colleton County, SCDNR and Givhans Ferry State Park access at all six selected endpoints, including parking, ramps and nearby state-park camping.

sourceAttempts.family: Edisto River Canoe and Kayak Trail sections
sourceAttempts.result: ERCK lists distinct Mars Oldfield–Givhans (6.5 mi), Givhans–Messervy (3 mi) and Messervy–Good Hope (4 mi) sections; the three longer routes combine those contiguous public sections with intermediate bailouts. It identifies Givhans–Messervy as a high-use summer float and New Cut as challenging.
USGS 02175000 is the direct stage station. Route-scoped aliases and endpoint-bounded traces follow the named Edisto River channel between the documented public access anchors.
Edisto River image is credited to KenB via Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 3.0 and is labeled same-river context.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: Direct Givhans gauge guidance applies to this upper/middle non-tidal batch; ERCK's 4–7 ft cue is used for easier New Cut passage.
